approval_required_for: Only if current exact-project discovery cannot uniquely bind the user-supplied wrapper/simulation-source hashes, Vivado export context, and authorized simulator executable; request a bounded evidence-backed identity-selection approval rather than guessing.

consumes: current case_board_interface_discovery report and exact user-supplied sample-project identity document
current exact wrapper and simulation-source hash manifest
current Vivado export facts, ordered source contexts, and authorized tool profile
immutable complete Transformer-block tensor catalog and DUT weight-binding requirements
immutable deterministic/real stimulus provenance and target-model inference reference outputs
immutable numeric policy and semantic-testbench contract
current SACG contamination barriers and open retry requests
executable_actions.on_failure: Keep case_axi_ddr_interface and functional_sim blocked as a verification-capability failure. Do not synthesize a simplified wrapper, choose an undocumented source/export/executable mapping, alter semantic inputs or tolerance, or patch RTL. If discovery cannot uniquely bind the exact project facts, emit a bounded identity-selection approval request with the competing cited artifacts.
produces: hash manifest proving unchanged exact wrapper/sample-project source hashes
executable_actions.rationale: Repair the earliest violated contract, not RTL. Materialize the missing board testbench and canonical simulation plan exclusively from the current exact sample-project identity, source hashes, Vivado export contexts, and authorized executable. Bind the immutable semantic contract to the same Transformer-block checkpoint, stimulus, target-model reference outputs, fixed numeric policy, and complete DUT weight-consumption requirements. The existing framework lacks the required direct certified-kernel boundary-probe materialization capability; planned_tool.direct_certified_kernel_boundary_probe_materializer must be implemented as a read-only observability extension without changing DUT RTL, user wrapper sources, model scope, golden data, or tolerance.

consumes: immutable target-model reference outputs, stimulus provenance, numeric policy, and Transformer-block tensor catalog
current exact wrapper and simulation-source hash manifest
executable_actions.on_failure: If static identity validation fails, return to repair.materialize_hash_bound_exact_board_harness. If VCS executes but reports value, liveness, protocol, ordering, AXI, or DDR failure, preserve its complete current trace and send it to repair.classify_current_boundary_trace_and_form_rerun_contract; do not claim functional pass or modify RTL. If the direct probe itself is unavailable or incomplete, classify that as the planned verifier-capability gap and keep hardware correctness unclaimed.
executable_actions.rationale: Once the identity-bound harness preflight is valid, execute the current board-layer simulator rather than reusing stale diagnosis. The replay must collect direct certified-kernel ingress, egress, accepted-handshake, start, and completion observations in the same adaptive stall snapshots, while retaining target-model-derived expected outputs and immutable numeric comparison inputs. This is the required current-layer boundary trace before any wrapper or lower-layer code repair.

consumes: current exact-board identity and source-hash manifests
connected-kernel timing knowledge and boundary-order contract
executable_actions.on_failure: Treat an incomplete, stale, or source-unbound trace as a current verification-capability blocker and repeat only the direct-boundary replay after repairing its instrumentation. Do not reopen operator leaves or the connected kernel, close any retry/barrier, or propose a causal RTL patch without an accepted localization record.
produces: conditional targeted lower-layer backtrack request only on an explicit certificate contradiction
SACG provenance update retaining active barriers and open retries pending Stage7 pass
executable_actions.rationale: Convert fresh real-tool evidence into the only permitted next repair decision. A board-local trace of no core ingress, blocked launch, or core egress not propagated localizes a bounded wrapper/harness/lifecycle slice. A lower-layer backtrack is permitted only if the current trace includes direct core start, ingress, egress, named causal-boundary facts, and current certificate hashes that explicitly contradict a named connected-kernel invariant. Preserve open SACG retry requests and active contamination barriers until a full successful Stage7 rerun promotes new evidence.

consumes: accepted hash-recorded bounded harness or board-wrapper remediation, if any
immutable checkpoint, stimulus, target-model reference, numeric policy, semantic-testbench contract, and exact board-wrapper source hashes
executable_actions.on_failure: Return the earliest failing current-layer evidence to repair.classify_current_boundary_trace_and_form_rerun_contract, retain all active contamination barriers and retry requests, and do not invoke Vivado/backend/board-runtime actions. A lower-layer replay may be scheduled only if the accepted current trace explicitly meets the lower-layer contradiction condition.
produces: fresh board-layer gate reports for interface, VCS, deadlock, multilayer functional, AXI protocol, DDR roundtrip, and semantic evidence
executable_actions.rationale: Only after the localization record accepts a bounded current-board harness/wrapper remediation, or confirms no additional causal repair is needed, rerun the failed board-layer gate DAG using the exact-board artifacts. This is the sole path to replace contaminated Stage7 evidence; it does not promote to backend merely because a subset of checks passes.

observations: The board-layer hierarchy is in needs_repair: case_axi_ddr_interface failed, functional_sim failed only because prerequisites blocked VCS execution, and the remaining board gates are not_run. Backend synthesis, implementation, bitstream, runtime-ABI release, and board runtime are prohibited.

case_axi_ddr_interface identifies a concrete harness-contract failure rather than an RTL symptom: the simulation source-identity hash, Vivado-export compile authority, ordered command authority references, and simulator executable authorization do not bind the discovered exact sample-project identity. The expected board_tb.sv is also absent.

The prior wrapper-level observation of completed ingress and zero accepted output beats is historical/planning evidence only because its diagnosis binding is stale. It neither proves a certified kernel defect nor authorizes a wrapper RTL replacement.

The required next diagnostic after a valid harness exists is a fresh read-only direct certified-kernel boundary trace with cycle-correlated input/output valid, ready, accepted counts, plus kernel lifecycle start/completion values. The probe endpoint must be resolved from the current exact-board identity/probe contract, not hardcoded by framework actions.

Operator-leaf and connected single-transformer-layer certificates are live hash-validated reusable evidence. No current trace explicitly contradicts a named invariant, so neither lower layer may be reopened. If a later trace does challenge the connected kernel, preserve its certified elastic variable-latency semantics: boundary order and cross-token overlap matter; unequal stage start/end cycles alone are not a failure.

Before any board functional pass, the exact board harness must bind the same immutable Transformer-block checkpoint tensor catalog, target-model reference outputs, input stimulus provenance, numeric policy, generated semantic-testbench hashes, and complete DUT weight-consumption proof. Embedding/tokenization and model-tail functions remain outside the DUT and its golden/weight scope.

sacg_memory_truth reports 15 active scoped contamination barriers and six open scoped retry requests. They keep prior Stage7/Stage8 results as planning/debug evidence only and block downstream consumption and promotion. No scoped open backtrack request exists. A refined repair candidate may be created, but these requests and barriers remain open until a successful current Stage7 rerun supersedes them.
The conditional design-team result is no_split; it supplies no substitute for deterministic tool evidence or for the required current direct-boundary replay.
proposed_actions: Materialize a hash-bound board simulation harness from the discovered exact sample project, including the missing board_tb.sv, canonical VCS plan, source/export/executable authority bindings, immutable semantic inputs, and a read-only direct-kernel probe contract. Do not modify DUT RTL or user sample-project sources.

After static identity and artifact checks pass, run the current exact-board VCS replay with direct-boundary monitoring and target-model-derived expected outputs. Treat a completed replay trace as localization evidence, not as a functional pass unless all semantic checks pass.

Use the fresh trace to produce a CCTG causal decision: repair the current board wrapper/harness slice when localization is board-local; request a targeted single-layer backtrack only when the trace, direct core ingress/egress/lifecycle facts, and current certificate hashes explicitly contradict a named lower-layer invariant.

After a localized repair outcome is accepted, rerun the complete current board-layer gate DAG in dependency order. Keep all SACG barriers and retry requests active until that rerun passes every required gate.
risks: A regenerated board testbench or VCS plan could silently substitute a simplified wrapper, stale source, unapproved simulator executable, or different Vivado export context. Hash-bind the exact user-supplied project wrapper and all simulation sources before execution.

Weight files and lower-layer certificates do not establish board-level consumption. A board pass requires complete Transformer-block tensor hashes, a bound loader/harness, and executed evidence that every required bound tensor was consumed.

Changing checkpoint, stimulus, target-model reference, tolerance, numeric policy, semantic-testbench contract, DUT scope, or exact board-wrapper source hashes during this loop would contaminate numeric/value comparison and is forbidden. Expected outputs must remain from target-model inference, never RTL or random generation.

Until the fresh direct trace is available, wrapper ingress, kernel launch, kernel retention, kernel egress, output backpressure, AXI/DDR progression, and lifecycle-frontier behavior are indistinguishable. A zero output frontier alone must not be treated as a root cause or as a lower-layer contradiction.

If exact-project discovery produces more than one plausible wrapper/source/export/executable binding, selecting one without cited evidence would invalidate board-level results and requires bounded approval rather than guessing.
Repeated static reruns without a newly hash-bound harness and direct-probe intervention would violate the anti-spin policy; each rerun must demonstrate fresh intervention-response evidence.

current Vivado export facts and authorized tool profile

edges: current direct certified-kernel boundary trace -> lower-layer backtrack decision

The only current direct failure is a verification-capability/harness failure: the exact board source identity, Vivado-export compile authority, command authority references, authorized simulator executable, and required board_tb.sv artifact are not bound. functional_sim is dependency-blocked and is not RTL, numeric, AXI, DDR, ordering, or liveness evidence. First materialize and validate the exact-project, hash-bound board harness and direct certified-kernel probe; then run a fresh current-layer replay and CCTG localization. Do not patch RTL, reopen either certified lower layer, or promote to backend/board runtime unless a current direct-boundary trace explicitly contradicts a named hash-bound lower-layer invariant.
